_comment: Required user secrets for local dev. Secrets listed here (non-_ keys) are checked by dev-setup.ps1.
_comment2: Set secrets with: dotnet user-secrets set "Key" "value" --project WebProject.AppHost
_comment3: Run scripts/dev-hydrate.ps1 to pull values automatically from the staging Key Vault.
_comment4: Key Vault secret names use '--' as separator (e.g. 'PostHog:ProjectToken' -> 'PostHog--ProjectToken').
_comment5: Optional integrations (PostHog, etc.) are configured in appsettings.local.json — no secrets required for local dev.
